title: My bookings
subtitle: Your bookings and monthly requests in one place.

upcoming.title: No upcoming bookings
upcoming.text: Bookings you make for hot desks and meeting rooms will appear here.

past.title: No past bookings
past.text: Completed and cancelled bookings will appear here.

requests.title: No requests waiting
requests.text: Requests for a dedicated desk or a private office will appear here while our team reviews them.

holdMinutes: Your slot is held for about {n} minutes.
holdSeconds: Your slot is held for less than a minute.
holdGone: The hold has ended and the slot was released.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this booking?
cancelDialog.textPlain: The booking is cancelled and the time goes back to the calendar.
cancelDialog.textPending: Your request is withdrawn. Nothing is charged.
cancelDialog.textPaid: The booking is cancelled and we record a refund request. Our team refunds you through the payment provider.
cancelDialog.textPackage: The booking is cancelled and the package balance used for it returns to you.

releaseDialog.title: Release this slot?
releaseDialog.text: The slot goes back to the calendar and nothing is charged. You can book it again if it is still free.

released: The slot for booking {ref} is released.
invoiceFailed: We could not download the invoice. Try again in a moment.

next.title: What happens next
next.draft: Your slot is held for you. Pay before the hold ends to confirm it.
next.pending: We received your request. Our team will review it and contact you about the deposit and invoice. You can follow the status here.
next.confirmedInstant: Your booking is confirmed. Come to reception at the start time.
next.confirmedRequest: Your request is approved. Our team will contact you about the start date. Invoices appear under Invoices.
next.completed: This booking is complete. Its invoice stays available under Invoices.
next.cancelledHold: The hold ended before payment, so the slot was released. Book the time again if you still need it.
next.cancelledStaff: Our team cancelled this booking. Contact us if you have questions.
next.noShow: You did not check in for this booking. Contact us if this is a mistake.

review.title: We are checking your payment
review.text: We received your payment after the held time expired, and the slot was no longer free. Our team will contact you and refund you.

returned.confirmingText: This usually takes a few seconds. You can stay on this page.
returned.slow: Confirmation can take a few minutes
returned.slowText: Your booking appears as Confirmed once the payment provider confirms the payment. You can leave this page and check again later.

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.refund: This booking is paid. If you cancel, we record a refund request and our team refunds you through the payment provider.
cancel.package: If you cancel, the package balance used for this booking returns to you.
cancel.pending: You can cancel this request while it is waiting for review.
cancel.closed: This booking can no longer be cancelled online. The cancellation window closed on {when}.
cancel.closedHelp: If you need to change it, contact us and we will help.
cancel.refundRecorded: A refund request is recorded. Our team refunds you through the payment provider.
cancel.packageReturned: The package balance used for this booking was returned.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.package: Your package balance covered this booking, so there is nothing to pay.
invoice.loadFailed: We could not load the invoice.
